tagline: A specialty materials company focused on activated carbon production and renewable forestry investments
hero_kpi_rationale: The improvement in gross margin of 1.8% in 2025 versus gross loss of -0.5% in 2024 (+2.3 points) reflects significant operational recovery following the reduction of unit production costs for activated carbon, indicating better efficiency despite lower volumes and restructuring context.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company from its core business activities of selling activated carbon.
kpis.description: Revenue derives primarily from activated carbon sales, complemented by air filtration products. The decline is attributable to a reduction in sales volumes from 43,989 tonnes in 2024 to 31,237 tonnes in 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in activated carbon sales due to volume reduction of 12,752 tonnes (29%).

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves considerably, moving from a gross loss of 0.18 million USD in 2024 to a profit of 0.65 million USD in 2025, primarily through a reduction in unit cost of activated carbon from 1,145 USD/tonne to 1,118 USD/tonne.
kpis.signal: Notable gross margin recovery from -0.5% to +1.8% thanks to 2.4% unit cost reduction.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit obtained after operating expenses, before taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Operating loss of 10.98 million USD in 2025 versus 12.49 million USD in 2024 reflects massive provisions for credit losses (8.9 million USD), partially offset by reductions in G&A and R&D expenses.
kpis.signal: Strongly negative operating margin due to provisions for credit losses and revenue decline.

kpis.name: R&D Spending (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses declined to 1,279 USD in 2025 versus 135,146 USD in 2024 following the halt of research and development programs decided in November 2023 as part of cost reduction measures.
kpis.signal: Near-total cessation of R&D investments since November 2023 as a cost-saving measure.

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Accounting provisions for receivables deemed uncollectible or at high risk.
kpis.description: Allowance for credit losses stands at 8.9 million USD, stable compared to 9.0 million USD in 2024. A significant provision of 18.2 million USD was recorded for an aged receivable, partially offset by reversals of 9.4 million USD on customer receivables and vendor advances.
kpis.signal: Stable but massive provisions reflecting elevated credit risk, notably a 18.2 million USD provision for aged receivables since September 2024.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net financial loss after all expenses, taxes and financial charges.
kpis.description: Net loss of 11.14 million USD in 2025 compared to 14.04 million USD in 2024 reflects improved profitability. Gains on subsidiary disposals (0.82 million USD) and reduced G&A expenses partially offset the revenue decline and credit loss provisions.
kpis.signal: Net loss reduced by 20.6% thanks to gains on subsidiary disposals and operational expense reduction.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.11 billion USD in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.0 billion USD in the latest year

risks.title: Nasdaq delisting risk and loss of liquidity
risks.score_rationale: Major risk positioned first in document (Item 3 Recent Developments). Intense language: 'delist', 'suspension of trading', 'penny stock', 'reduced liquidity'. Upward trend: two reverse splits (1:30 in 2024, 1:25 in 2025), delisting notice issued January 16, 2026, appeal pending. Critical impact on future financing capacity.

risks.title: Dependence on Chinese regulation and VIE structure risk
risks.score_rationale: Major structural risk repeated 4 times in Item 3 ('Risks Relating to Doing Business in the PRC'). Intense language: 'significantly limit or completely hinder', 'value of securities significantly decline or be worthless'. Majority of operations in China via VIE structure. Stable trend but very high categorical weight.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk and CAC data review
risks.score_rationale: Specific PRC risk explicitly mentioned in Item 3 with technical details ('Cyberspace Administration of China', 1 million user threshold). Moderate but precise language. Stable trend: currently not subject (< 1M users), but emerging risk if expansion. Medium categorical weight for tech/automation sector.

risks.title: Shareholder control concentration and governance risk
risks.score_rationale: Major governance risk: Ms. Yefang Zhang controls 86.4% of voting power via irrevocable proxy agreement (September 2025). Position in Item 3 (Recent Developments). Clear language: 'irrevocable proxy', 'controls approximately 86.4%'. Upward trend: concentration increased via recent agreement. Impact on minority shareholders and strategic decisions.

risks.title: Dependence on convertible debt financing and dilution
risks.score_rationale: Major capital risk: three convertible debt instruments in 2024-2026 (Streeterville: $7.51M in January 2026, $3.15M in October 2024, $3.23M in April 2025). Technical language: 'convertible', 'floor price', 'original issue discount'. Upward trend: rapid accumulation of convertible debt. High dilutive impact on existing shareholders.

risks.title: Integration risk and operational risk from Blessing Logistics acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Major acquisition risk announced January 25, 2026: acquisition of 82% of Blessing Logistics (Canadian oil trader) for approximately $2M in stock. Moderate language: 'framework agreement', 'subject to change', 'due diligence'. New trend: very recent agreement, 60-day timeline for definitive agreement. Medium categorical weight (business diversification).

risks.title: Non-core business diversification and strategic risk
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk: highly fragmented portfolio (China specialty materials, North America robotics/automation, Canada oil trading). Implicit language: 'holding company with no material operations of its own'. Upward trend: recent addition of Blessing Logistics. Medium categorical weight but impact on strategic focus.

risks.title: Liquidity risk and dependence on PRC subsidiary dividends
risks.score_rationale: Specific PRC liquidity risk: holding company with no core operations, dependent on dividends from Chinese subsidiaries. Intense language: 'materially adverse effect on our ability to conduct our business'. Stable trend but very high categorical weight for offshore structure. PRC restrictions on capital repatriation.

ai_positioning.summary: CNEY makes no mention of artificial intelligence initiatives in its financial or operational documents. The company focuses on activated carbon production and renewable forestry investments, with traditional operational cost optimization measures.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning or advanced automation in 20-F and 6-K filings
R&D investments were halted since November 2023 as a cost reduction measure
Strategic initiatives focus on optimizing unit production costs and acquiring operating subsidiaries
